x-m-e1-05.title: Ukuhlola isimangalo esithi "Uma ligingqika, kuyisimo sebhola"
x-m-e1-05.goal: Hlola ukuthi isimangalo esithi "Konke okugingqikayo kuyisimo sebhola" silungile yini usebenzisa izimpawu zezinto eziningana, bese ulungisa isimangalo ukuze silunge.
x-m-e1-05.material: U-Seojun wathi, "Konke okugingqikayo kuyisimo sebhola. Imbumbulu iyagingqika futhi ibhola lebhola lamanyathelo liyagingqika!" Egumbini kukhona imbumbulu, ibhola lebhola lamanyathelo, ibhokisi lokudla okulula (isimo sebhokisi), nethini lokuphuza (isimo sesilinda). (Ithini linengaphezulu nengezansi eziyisicaba, eziyindilinga, futhi uhlangothi lugoqeke ngokuphelele.)
x-m-e1-05.prereq.0: Ukubona nokuqamba amagama ezimo zebhokisi, zesilinda, nezebhola (izinga le-Grade 1)
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela yokubonisa ukuthi isimangalo sika-Seojun siyiphutha?
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ngezinto ezine esegumbini ngokukodwa, bese ubhala ngayinye ukuthi "iyagingqika?" nokuthi "iyisimo sebhola?"
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Buka lokho obukubhalile bese ubona ukuthi ikhona yini ilayini ephikisana nesitatimende sika-Seojun.
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.r.a: Imbumbulu iyisimo sebhola, ngakho ayiphikisani nesitatimende sika-Seojun.
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.o.b: Beka ithini lokuphuza ohlangothini bese lilingqika
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.r.b: Uhlole isitatimende ngokuthola into egingqikayo kodwa engeyona isimo sebhola.
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.r.c: Ibhola lebhola lamanyathelo liyisimo sebhola, ngakho alikuphikisani nesitatimende sika-Seojun.
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.r.d: Ibhokisi kunzima ukulingqika, ngakho alikuphikisani nesitatimende sokuthi izinto ezigingqikayo ziyizimo zebhola.
x-m-e1-05.s.s1.explain: Ukubonisa ukuthi isimangalo sika-Seojun siyiphutha, udinga into eyodwa kuphela egingqikayo kodwa engeyona isimo sebhola. Ithini liyisimo sesilinda, futhi liyagingqika uma ulibeka ohlangothini ulisunduze.
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.prompt: Yini ongathanda ukutshela u-Seojun yona? Sebenzisa into eyisibonelo ukulungisa isimangalo sika-Seojun futhi usibhale kahle.
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale igama nesimo sento oyikhethe nje.
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala nokuthi uyenza kanjani leyo nto igingqike.
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe kucacile ukuthi into oyinikeze ayiyona isimo sebhola?
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi izimo zebhola akuzona kuphela ezigingqikayo?
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange nokuthi ulibeka kanjani ukuze ligingqike?
x-m-e1-05.s.s2.model.0: Cha. Ithini lokuphuza liyisimo sesilinda, kodwa uma ulibeka phansi uligingqa, liyagingqika. Akuzona izimo zebhola kuphela ezigingqikayo.
